<Picture 1> is the first frame of the target video at 0.00 seconds; the mid keyframe guide aligns with the 3.00-second mark; the last-frame guide aligns with the 6.58-second mark.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action historical documentary style, 35mm film look, desaturated cool slate palette with amber highlights, soft overcast daylight, low contrast, subtle film grain, gentle vignette. The opening frame exactly matches <Picture 1>: a low-angle medium shot of the Xianyang city gate. The earthen rammed-earth wall dominates the frame, with a dark wooden-framed doorway slightly right of center, its doors half-open and the interior dim. Sandy ground with wheel ruts lies before the gate, a few loose stones in the lower right corner. Light comes from the upper left; the left and upper areas are empty. The camera is static, then pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. No people are present. At 1.00 second, the character in <Picture 3> emerges step by step from the dark passage of the doorway onto the sandy road, walking toward the camera. Around the neck, the off-white braided cord loop of <Picture 4> is tightened against the side of the neck, the knot hanging on the chest. The right hand holds the square body of <Picture 5>, thumb on its edge; the left hand grips the middle of the staff of <Picture 6>, fingertips on the raised ring, its reddish-brown ribbon hanging from the top down beside the wrist. Both hands hold the objects between chest and abdomen. Legs move together in slow, steady steps, black cloth shoes clearly visible on the sandy ground. Gaze is level, expression composed and grave. On the right side of the same frame, on the yellow earth rutted road, <Picture 7> is parked whole, its plain carriage side panels and wheels facing the camera, no paint or bronze ornaments, thin mud on the lower edge and wheels. No other person, no soldiers, no gifts, no ceremonial guards appear. At 3.00 seconds, the camera cuts to a medium eye-level static shot. On the rutted yellow earth road outside the doorway, <Picture 7> is parked on the right side of the frame, its shafts pointing toward the front left. The plain carriage boards and two wheels face the camera, thin mud on the lower rims and undercarriage. The character in <Picture 3> stands half a step to the left of the carriage, body facing the camera. The cord loop of <Picture 4> is against the neck, the knot on the chest. The right hand holds the square body of <Picture 5>, thumb on the edge; the left hand grips the middle of the staff of <Picture 6>, fingertips on the raised ring, the reddish-brown ribbon hanging beside the wrist. Legs are together, black cloth shoes clearly on the rutted road. Gaze is level, expression composed and grave. Then the camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed to a close-up eye-level shot. The character in <Picture 3> is centered, hands together in front of the chest, palms up: the right palm supports the square base of <Picture 5>, the left palm supports the middle of the staff of <Picture 6> with its reddish-brown ribbon hanging beside the wrist. The cord loop of <Picture 4> is tight against the neck, the knot on the chest. Legs are together, black cloth shoes on the ground. Gaze is level, expression grave and calm. Behind him on the right, the plain white side panel and one wheel outline of <Picture 7> are visible, wood seams and spokes clear in the cool white daylight. The dark passage of the doorway recedes behind him, thin dust floating in the light beam. No other person, no soldiers, no gifts, no ceremonial guards appear. The video ends exactly on the final frame guide.

overall_soundscape: Soft overcast wind over earthen walls, faint dry rustle of sand under slow footsteps, a light creak of wooden carriage wheels at rest, distant hollow echo from the dark doorway, and the subtle whisper of fabric and cord as the character moves and stands.
